kind: source-only endpoint and cold metadata trigger review; no cloud access or workload run

endpoint_chain.finding: S3 lower receives create_s3_client(args), endpoint args.s3_endpoint; same client opens manifest and builds PackedReadonly.
PackedLowerBinding has version, base_layer_id, manifest only; no endpoint override.

prewarm_chain.finding: Absent upper dentry resolves through lower.metadata.lookup_with_attr_bytes.
Cold leaf lookup calls authenticated snapshot.lookup_dentry.
lookup_dentry immediately requests reader.group_metadata, before pread.
Old helper opens all leaf FDs serially before begin_wave; target events are only recorded while enabled. It therefore misses metadata fills caused by preopens.

parent_directory_open_chain.finding: Packed workspace opendir delegates to packed_opendir.
Validates parent attrs/fences, opens lower paged handle and probes upper dentry pages; no lower child read_page.
Only II05 directory type and paged source construction; no child GroupMeta decode.
Generic pre-load comment is not what Packed paged implementation does; no additional VFS prefetch is executed here.

minimal_guard_protocol: Keep fresh mount and exact same baseline/candidate config/data.
Record proxy method/key-hash/Range/status/bytes and phase for setup and measured requests; no credentials/Authorization/query. Retain totals to distinguish endpoint bypass from prewarming.
Preopen only unique parent directories dNN with O_DIRECTORY and no readdir/scandir/leaf stat; wait proxy idle. Root/parent metadata may be warm and must be disclosed.

Do not preopen leaf files. Release all workers from a barrier, then openat f00 relative to prepared parentFD, pread4096 and close within measured interval. Scope is cold leaf lookup/open plus payload read, not pread-only.
Assert exactly1/8 unique exact GroupMeta ranges during measured wave, each206/exact length, no errors; same-key must fetch once; all8 payload SHA checks must pass.
Compare setup and wave target identities; if expected leaf group was consumed before barrier or no exact targets are seen, fail closed.

Use all-phase proxy audit to confirm actual endpoint and phase; frozen ca issue binaries do not expose Packed native counters because existing extension wiring is unsupported, so do not invent zero counters.
decision: Source supports revised parent-open plus concurrent leaf-open/read protocol; actual new EC4 source cause and timing still require archived runtime audit.
